task: Schedule the hand-off meeting for wrenfold-app, then write the release hand-off note file on the staged rollout, its environment flags as env-file lines, and the attached screenshots.
rationale: The artifact is a release hand-off note for the support team: which months the staged rollout runs through, what share of users it has reached, the environment flags that switch it on, and pointers to the screenshots of the new screens. Booking the hand-off meeting, filing the note in a doc space, and house rules for month names, percentages, flag assignments and screenshot references all belong to one hand-over. The five scheduling tools are identical stubs that create the same calendar event, the five doc spaces are opaque slot codes, and the task gives the note months, a share, flags and screenshots to write without naming any convention, so every option stays as reasonable as its rivals; every member chosen is a token a writer adds only on purpose, so a note that ignores both members of a group reads as neither.
